research_scope: Fresh direct-source race-restriction audit for six older CaC-usable skills retaining null race_restriction.

records.name: Impact Flare
records.evidence: Current skill reference identifies the PQ150 skill and Jiren (Full Power) as user; current sources do not state a CaC race/gender/form restriction.

records.name: Power Wall
records.evidence: Current skill reference identifies PQ150 and Jiren (Full Power)/customize partner usage; no direct CaC race/gender/form restriction is stated.

records.name: Neo Wolf Fang Fist
records.evidence: Current skill reference identifies PQ86 acquisition and Yamcha/customize partner usage; no direct CaC race/gender/form restriction is stated.

records.name: Final Kamehameha
records.evidence: Current skill reference lists TP Medal Shop, PQ91, and Double Crystal Raids and Vegito/SSGSS Vegito including Customize Partner; no direct CaC race/gender/form restriction is stated.

records.name: Maiden Burst
records.evidence: Current Evasive reference lists PQ92 and Pan/Videl Customize Partner/Ribrianne usage; no direct CaC race/gender/form restriction is stated.

records.name: Bluff Kamehameha
records.evidence: Current skill reference lists PQ94 and Gogeta (SS4)/customize partner usage; current partner customization also lists it for Gogeta SS4, but neither establishes a narrower CaC race/gender/form rule.

policy: Character ownership, customize-partner availability, and CaC availability are not themselves proof of unrestricted all-race eligibility. Keep null unless direct race/gender/form evidence exists.
next: Continue the remaining restriction-gap cohort, prioritizing sources that explicitly distinguish CaC race or gender requirements.
